title: Reset or move your two-factor (2FA) device
snippet: Settings → Security → Two-factor → 'Move to a new device'. Use a backup code if the old phone is gone; codes regenerate after use.

title: Reset a forgotten password
snippet: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page. Links expire after 30 minutes; check spam for mail from no-reply@acme.dev.

title: Refunds and duplicate charges
snippet: Duplicate charges under $100 are auto-refunded by support after confirming both captures in the billing ledger. Refunds land in 5–10 business days.

title: Exporting projects to CSV
snippet: Projects → ⋯ → Export CSV. Exports over 50k rows are emailed. A 500 during export usually means a worker incident — check status.acme.dev.

title: Account and data deletion requests
snippet: Deletion and GDPR/CCPA requests are handled by the Privacy team within 30 days. Support must not action deletions directly.

title: Adding or removing seats
snippet: Admins can change seat count under Billing → Plan. Changes prorate to the next invoice.
